subject: Clarify product output rights and feedback license for Beta.ai order form
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@beta.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Vega <markus.vega@beta.ai>, Beta.ai Legal <legal@beta.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Beta.ai redlines on MSA and order form – data & feedback clauses

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our legal team reviewed the MSA and attached an annotated order form with three areas we need clarity on before procurement can sign:

1) Output ownership: Draft currently gives the customer "rights to use" outputs but also contains a broad training carve-out for Redwood. We need explicit confirmation that Beta.ai owns outputs for customer-specific prompts and can use them internally for product development.

2) Feedback license: You allowed Redwood to use customer feedback to improve models; we need a limited, non-exclusive license that excludes PII and does not permit resale as a stand-alone model.

3) Data retention & provenance: We'd like a short SLA for retention and a statement about log exportability for audits.

Attached is our redlined MSA and a proposed order form. Can we get your counterpoints and an internal point of contact to expedite? Procurement is aiming for signature by end of May.

Best,
Olivia
Senior Counsel, Beta.ai

Attachment: beta_msa_redlines_20250517.docx (docx)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@beta.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2025 10:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Beta.ai redlines on MSA and order form – data & feedback clauses

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear summary and the redlines. Looping in Kar (sales/contract lead), Laura (legal ops), and Vanessa (privacy/compliance) to get us aligned internally.

Quick asks from our side so we can respond with a consolidated position:
- Kar: can you confirm the expected term/scale of the deployment? This will affect our ability to make training concessions.
- Laura/Vanessa: we’ll need proposed language for the feedback license that protects Beta.ai PII while allowing Redwood to improve models across customers. Also need your read on an exportable log statement.

Olivia — I can target a redlined response by Tuesday (20 May). If procurement needs a faster cadence, tell us and I’ll prioritize.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_response_track_changes.pdf (pdf)

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2025 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Beta.ai redlines on MSA and order form – data & feedback clauses

Team — drafting notes and recommended positions below (high level):

1) Output ownership
- Recommend we offer: customer retains rights to outputs generated from their prompts and data (explicit clause). However, Redwood requires a narrow operational license to cache/serve those outputs for the customer and to run diagnostics. We should avoid granting Beta.ai rights to "recreate" or redistribute a model derived solely from their outputs.
- Suggested language snippet: "Customer retains rights to use and distribute Outputs produced by Customer-specific prompts. Redwood is granted a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to store and process Outputs solely to provide the Services, perform diagnostics, and comply with SLAs."

2) Feedback license
- We can accept a feedback license limited to anonymized, non-PII signals used to improve models. Must exclude raw transcripts containing PII or proprietary datasets.
- Suggested: "Customer hereby grants Redwood a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide license to use anonymized Feedback for service improvement; Feedback will be aggregated and de-identified per our privacy procedures. Redwood will not use Feedback to create a customer-specific model for resale."

3) Data retention & provenance
- Offer a retention table in the order form (e.g., logs 30 days, request traces 90 days, customer-exportable audit logs on 30-day notice). Provide an export mechanism (S3/Drive link) for audit artifacts.

Action items:
- Vanessa to confirm whether our anonymization process and retention table meet Beta.ai's procurement bar.
- Kar to confirm deployment size and whether Beta.ai expects training rights (if they want model retrain we need separate commercial terms).

If everyone signs off, I’ll produce a tracked-change response to Olivia by Monday evening.

—Laura
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: data_use_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@beta.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Beta.ai redlines on MSA and order form – data & feedback clauses

Hi Olivia — thanks for your patience. Attached is our consolidated response (tracked changes) and a short summary of the points below. High-level compromise we can accept:

- Customer ownership of Outputs: Redwood confirms Beta.ai retains rights to Outputs generated from Customer-specific prompts and data. Redwood will maintain a limited operational license to store and process Outputs to deliver the Service and meet support obligations.

- Feedback license: Redwood can accept a limited feedback license that is
  • non-exclusive, royalty-free
  • limited to anonymized/aggregated signals
  • excludes PII, proprietary datasets, and any content flagged by Customer as "do not use for model training"
  • expressly prohibits Redwood from creating and reselling a customer-specific model trained primarily on Customer data without separate commercial terms.

- Data retention & auditability: We propose a retention schedule (logs 30d, traces 90d) and an audit export process (S3 link on request with 30-day lead). See attached matrix for details.

Next steps: if this aligns, can Beta.ai's legal accept the tracked changes and we’ll route to procurement to finalize the order form? Happy to jump on a 30-minute call if any clause needs fine tuning.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_response_track_changes.pdf (pdf); data_use_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)
